reply.analysis: Proven: the bracket is [455, 455] for 1820 receivers. The lower bound is an independent set of size 455, and the upper bound is a linear code over F_2 with c = 1 that meets it. All four checks passed: independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding. The agent tried one code, used 2 LLM calls and one critic round, and the critic accepted. Wall time was 106.277 s, of which 92.367 s was compute and 13.91 s was LLM time, so compute dominates. No baselines were run, so nothing can be said about wins or losses against them. Nothing looks suspicious: the hypothesis K(16,4) matches the numbers and the bound equals 455.
